observations.brake_bearings_overview.png: Both populated joints sit between the central case and planetary cases; the large cases obscure most bearing detail. Rear bridge form remains a coarse inferred casting profile.
observations.brake_bearing_section.png: Horizontal half-section exposes both integral rear saddle connections and one bush/cap/journal stack. Unshown central gears are omitted only from this inspection selection.
observations.brake_bearing_close_section.png: Focused saved-solid section shows the continuous flanged bush around adjacent journals, the radial dowel crossing the cap/bush seat, and the preserved inner spline/sleeve layers.
observations.brake_bearing_joint.png: Separate flanged bush, forward cap, two stud/nut/cotter sets and the outside dowel receiver are visible; rear saddle deliberately omitted from this selection.
observations.brake_bearing_fastener.png: Castle slots, cross-hole and both formed cotter legs visible. Both printed stud-length claims remain explicit in the caption.
observations.brake_bearing_overlay.png: SNL22 shaft-height overlay retains inherited registration. Cap/bush now occupy the depicted support region. Rear bridge, case shoulder and hub profiles still differ; source drum silhouette remains larger than printed381mm OD.
observations.brake_bearing_comparison.png: Side-by-side crop makes the same offsets clear. Dowel source glyph is longer than source-sized model pin; printed5/8x1/2 retained. No source warping or independent metrology claim.

limitations: Shared-bush architecture and M263 rear saddle/cap allocation are documented hypotheses; unshown casting form remains approximate.
Bronze shading of M265 is a display/material assumption; only M300 bronze is explicit in the cited catalogue.
No bearing lubrication route or full transmission installation sequence qualified.
